title: BNP Paribas action: on a major support - Flash IG analysis 15.03.2018
description: According to Reuters, BNP Paribas is preparing to acquire the Polish branch of the Austrian Bank Raiffeisen, whose assets amount to 1.5 billion euros and whose real estate loan portfolio is evaluated at almost 2.3 billion euros. Of the graphic point of view, BNP Paribas is evolving without much medium -term trend, as the behavior of its mobile average. Six months. The return of the value on its major support could however arouse a renewed appetite from the buyer current, as evidenced by the low wicks as this level approached in recent weeks. The current timing is therefore conducive in order to envisage a recovery phase which could bring the courses in contact with the 65.90EUrs during the next sessions. This scenario would however be invalidated in the event of a break in the 61.10EUR. asr.full_text: Welcome to Flash Analyze with IG. Today is Thursday March 15th 2018 and it is 2 p.m. Here is the analysis of the BNP Paribas. According to Reuters, BNP is about to take over the Polish branch of the Austrian bank Raffhausen whose assets rise to 1.05 billion euros, and with almost 2.3 billion euros million euros and whose money in stock portfolio is valued at close to 2,3 billion euros. From a graphic point of view, BNP PARIBAS is getting a lot of tendency in the medium term, as shown by the behavior of its daily mobile mean, flat since six months. The return of a value on the major support can provoke a better appetite on the part of the buyer's shares, as are the lessons learned at this level in recent weeks. The current timings are therefore conducive to consider a recovery phase that could take back up to cost of 0.6590 during the following sessions This scenario would be in case of a break of 0.610. This was the flash analysis with IG, Have a nice day, see you soon
